Help.title: How can we help?
Help.subtitle: Find answers fast, or message MÂY and we will reply within 24 hours.
Help.noResults: No matching answer yet. Send us a message below.

items.a: MÂY accepts cash on delivery, VietQR bank transfer (confirmed automatically within seconds) and VNPay for ATM, Visa and Mastercard.

items.q: How do I use a discount code?
items.a: Enter it at checkout and press Apply. One code per order; codes may have a minimum order value and a validity period.
Yes, while it is still pending. Open Track order (or your account) and press Cancel order; any payment is refunded.
Standard delivery takes 2–4 working days nationwide. 2-hour express delivery is available in central Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi.
Standard delivery is free from 500,000₫. Below that it costs 30,000₫; express costs 50,000₫.

items.q: How do I track my order?
items.a: Use Track order with your order code and the email or phone number you used. You also get an email whenever the status changes.
Free exchanges or returns within 30 days, as long as items are unwashed with their tags on.

items.q: When will I get my money back?
items.a: Once we receive the items, refunds are sent within 3–5 working days to your original payment method.

items.q: How do I pick the right size?
items.a: Press “Find your size” on any product page and enter your height and weight. If you are between two sizes, choose the larger one.

items.q: How should I care for linen?
items.a: Machine wash at 30°C, no bleach, dry in the shade and iron on low. Linen gets softer with every wash.

About.title: Clothes for beautifully ordinary days.
About.lead: MÂY started as a small sewing workshop in District 3 with a simple idea: make fewer pieces, and make them really well.
About.manifesto: A good shirt should stay with you for years, not a season. So we choose fabrics carefully, sew slowly, and only release new pieces when they are truly needed.
About.processTitle: How a piece comes to life

process.title: Sketch
process.text: Every design starts from a real need: cooler, neater, easier to wear.

process.title: Fabric
process.text: Organic cotton, linen and recycled fabrics, washed many times before we choose.

process.title: Hand finishing
process.text: Our District 3 team sews and checks every seam.

process.title: Thoughtful packing
process.text: Recycled paper, no single-use plastic, delivered to your door.
